items.title: The Hitchhiker’s Guide to Training on Compute Islands (Core Automation)
items.summary: “The biggest bottleneck in deployment of accelerated compute is not the chips themselves but power, grid equipment and land,” the authors write. “The bottleneck that holds most organizations back is not the raw amount of compute, but the ability to turn islands of compute into one valuable frontier training run.”
